data.narrative:
Firefly Aerospace is a publicly traded Space & Aerospace company founded by Tom Markusic. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private frontier-tech companies in the same sector, including Rocket Lab, Planet Labs, Astroscale, SpaceX, and ICEYE.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach here. Firefly's three closest public-stage comparables—Rocket Lab ($40.0B), Planet Labs ($7.6B), and Astroscale ($840M)—yield a median valuation of $7.6B. This range spans $840M to $40.0B, reflecting material variance in scale and maturity within the sector. A Public-Comp anchoring approach using the Space & Aerospace sector's median P/S multiple of 27.4x across 6 tickers cannot be applied because Firefly's revenue is not disclosed.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $6.4B (low) to $8.7B (high), centered on $7.6B. The current market valuation of approximately $2.9B sits meaningfully below this range. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion among public comparables—a 48x spread between Astroscale and Rocket Lab—and the absence of revenue-based cross-checks. Additional refinement would require Firefly's revenue disclosure to apply multiples-based methods and narrow the valuation band.
